area: the team rules, /ship, /swimlanes, the hooks and the Claude tooling
summary: Only a swim lane collision now stops a change to someone else's work; everything else goes through with a heads-up and an entry in the owner's new /approve queue (approvals.py, /approve skill, Docs/Approvals).
why: Approval before every change to others' work was slowing everyone down (Garrett, 2026-11-10). Posting to the live backend still goes through you first.
